Read by tools/ci/check-dep-age.mjs (freshness gate) and tools/ci/check-audit.mjs (a High/Critical advisory on a listed package fails regardless of any waiver). Entry: { name, version, kind: direct-stale | deprecated-transitive, via: [parent chain], reason, decision: DECISIONS.md ID, review_by, expires: YYYY-MM-DD, exit_criteria }. An unexpired entry passes; an expired entry fails (a new decision is required, never a silent extension). New entries need a principal-architect decision and security-analyst review (CODEOWNERS).

exceptions.name: bcrypt
exceptions.reason: Fixed-stack password hashing library (brief section 3); 6.0.0 published 2025-05-11T18:06Z is the latest release and crossed 18 months on 2026-11-11; no advisory; N-API prebuilds load on Node 24 under --ignore-scripts.
exit_criteria: an advisory of severity >= Medium against bcrypt or its prebuild loader
an ADR-0001 Node major on which the 6.0.0 prebuild fails the SEC-TC-45 bcrypt case
2027-05-11 reached with no release; exit = bcryptjs 3.x behind the PasswordHasher port

exceptions.name: node-abort-controller
exceptions.reason: Deprecated polyfill pinned exactly by bullmq 6.7.x; on Node 24 bullmq prefers globalThis.AbortController, so the module loads and is never instantiated; MIT, zero dependencies, no install script, no advisory.
exceptions.review_by: 2027-05-12 and at every BullMQ minor bump
exceptions.exit_criteria: BullMQ drops the dependency (remove the entry); an advisory triggers security-analyst reachability re-evaluation and a principal-architect ruling within the wave
